explanationMd: The passage contrasts colour variation with customers’ expectation that tiles look alike. “Uniformity” therefore means visual consistency. It is distinct from functional strength or the amount of recycled content.

distractorRationale.e: The word refers to the product’s visual qualities.
distractorRationale.d: Water absorption is a separate functional test.
distractorRationale.b: Customer pricing agreement is not discussed.
